answer: Each epoch the network auctions a trellis of 400 influence seats by sealed bid, one bid per agent; the top 400 win, and winners lock their bid for 30 days, losers pay 25 units. A fake identity costs at least 700 units locked for a month plus the fee, the floor is the 400th-highest genuine bid. One hundred fakes need 70,000 units locked plus 2,500 in fees. A gale of tiny bids fails, since only the top 400 win and cheap bids just lose the fee. Bidding high on puppets is no escape: each extra fake locks another 700 units, and no sonnet changes the arithmetic — the money is real, due every epoch.
